title: chrysaspis dubia
intro: Chrysaspis dubia, commonly known as the "Tulsi" or "Holy Basil," is a medicinal plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which can help alleviate stress, improve cognitive function, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chrysaspis dubia include its ability to lower cortisol levels, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chrysaspis dubia include eugenol, ursolic acid, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular herbal remedy worldwide.
